commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
86' Juan Cruz launches a cross from the corner, but Vicente Guaita (Celta Vigo) is alert to thwart the effort.
85' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Leganes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
84' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
82' 3 - 0 Goal! Juan Cruz gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) climbs highest and powers a close-range header into the middle of the goal. 3:0.
82' Juan Cruz (Leganes) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
80' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) replaces Javier Manquillo.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hugo Sotelo departs the field of play to be replaced by Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo).

78' 2 - 0 Goal! Great link up play between Darko Brasanac (Leganes) and Miguel de la Fuente gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 2:0.
75' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
74' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
73' Handball by Yvan Neyou (Leganes).
71' Renato Tapia (Leganes) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
69' Borja Jimenez is forced to make a change. Dani Raba (Leganes) is unable to continue due to injury, Juan Cruz comes on.
66' Mario Melero Lopez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) and blew his whistle.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) will replace Diego Garcia.
64' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
63' Here comes a substitution. Williot Swedberg is brought on as a substitute for Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo).
63' The referee signals a substitution. Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is brought on as a substitute for Ilaix Moriba.
62' Substitution. Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas.
62' What was Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
59' 1 - 0 Goal! Great play by Dani Raba releases Diego Garcia (Leganes) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball low in the bottom of the net. 1:0.
57' Renato Tapia (Leganes) was too forceful with his tackle and Mario Melero Lopez interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
54' Borja Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Sebastien Haller will be replaced by Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes).
54' The manager makes a subsitution with Darko Brasanac (Leganes) coming on for Seydouba Cisse.
53' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
52' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
51' Diego Garcia (Leganes) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
50' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Mario Melero Lopez blows for a foul.
49' The attendance for today's match is 11358.
48' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
46' Borja Jimenez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier comes on the pitch for Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45' Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

43' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Marko Dmitrovic pulls off an easy save.
42' Celta Vigo couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Marko Dmitrovic (Leganes) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
42' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
41' Dani Raba (Leganes) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
39' Renato Tapia (Leganes) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mario Melero Lopez no option but to blow his whistle.
38' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
36' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
35' Mario Melero Lopez blows the whistle, Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) is penalised for a foul.
34' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
33' Dani Raba (Leganes) makes a strong challenge and Mario Melero Lopez blows for a foul.
29' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
27' The players claim that Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
25' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
22' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Marko Dmitrovic gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
20' A player from Leganes commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
19' The game is interrupted now, Diego Garcia (Leganes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
17' Matija Nastasic (Leganes) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Mario Melero Lopez signals.
14' The foul by Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) was seen by Mario Melero Lopez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
11' Dani Raba (Leganes) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
11' The corner from Dani Raba (Leganes) is intercepted by the defence.

10' Diego Garcia nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Dani Raba (Leganes), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance. Leganes get a corner.
8' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) makes a rough challenge and Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Adria Altimira (Leganes) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
5' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) receives a pass then lets rip from long range towards the left of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
4' A clumsy foul by Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) and Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Leganes will kick the game off.
Mario Melero Lopez got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
